theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.stdTwoBelow3_jmRaw_comm {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (i k : ℕ) (hi : i < 3) (hk : k < 3) :
jmRawB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) i * jmRawB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) k = jmRawB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) k * jmRawB (stdTwoBelow3 q hq) i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRawB_comm_adjacent {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (i : ℕ) (h : i + 1 < n) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRawB_eq_one_add_addJMB {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (k : ℕ) (hkn : k < n) :
jmRawB H k = 1 + addJMB H (q - q⁻¹) k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.addJMB_comm {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (d : R) (i k : ℕ) (hin : i < n) (hkn : k < n) :
addJMB H d i * addJMB H d k = addJMB H d k * addJMB H d i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.addJMB_comm_of_le {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (d : R) (i m : ℕ) (h : i ≤ m) (hmn : m + 1 < n) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.partialSumB_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} {n : ℕ} (H : HeckeGeneratorsBelow R A q n) (d : R) (m : ℕ) :
